        public java.util.ArrayList<Var> execute(NodeList inargs,
                                        NodeList outargs,

                                        boolean is_input,

        Execute the variable declaration procedure str().
        Overrides:
        execute in class InbuiltProc
        Parameters:
        inargs - is a list of input argument tree nodes
        outargs - is a list of output argument tree nodes
        names - is a list of identifiers evaluated via method getIdents() prior to calling execute()
        par_arg - is an argument passed to this variable as a parameter in a call
        dim_des - is a dimensional description for a compound constant argument or is null - it must be null here!
        is_input - is true if this variable is the input parameter for a module, procedure or function
        is_output - is true if this variable is the output parameter for a module or procedure
        Returns:
        list containing the variable(s)
